items.stem: What are the three main parts of a simple story?

options.rationale: Correct: stories are shaped as beginning, middle and end.
A story has one title, not three parts of titles.
A story needs a beginning and middle too.
Spellings are not the parts of a story.

items.stem: Which sentence uses the most vivid, descriptive language?

options.text: The huge, shaggy dog bounded across the muddy field.
options.rationale: Correct: strong adjectives and a vivid verb paint a clear picture.

options.text: The dog went in the field.
options.rationale: This is plain with no description.
This gives no detail at all.
This is not even a full descriptive sentence.

items.explanation: Correct: strong adjectives and a vivid verb paint a clear picture.
